Indicator_Name_JP: 学力達成度分布
Definition: Distribution of subject- and domain-level achievement on national and municipal assessments, including mean, quartiles, SD, and skewness, providing a comprehensive academic profile beyond a simple average.
Data_Source: MEXT National Assessment of Academic Ability and Learning Status; municipal assessments
Threshold: Within national mean ±1SD: normal; -1SD to -2SD: caution (yellow); below -2SD: warning (red); |skewness|>1.0: distribution anomaly
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Curriculum Supervisor)
Action_Trigger: When sustained below -1SD or when distribution skews abnormally, commission Value-Added Model analysis controlling for SDoL and review curriculum policy.
Rationale: Corresponds to a population-level vital sign in PHM; distinguishes attainment from growth via Value-Added Modeling to separate pure educational effects from SDoL confounders.

Indicator_Name_JP: 不登校発生率
Definition: Share of enrolled students with annual long-term absence (>=30 days) attributed to school refusal; tracked both as stock prevalence and new-incidence (flow).
Data_Source: MEXT Survey on Problem Behavior and School Non-Attendance; school administrative attendance records
Threshold: YoY +5%: caution; +10%: warning; >1.5x national mean: critical (structural-factor analysis); 3 consecutive monthly increases: trend alert
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Student Guidance Supervisor)
Action_Trigger: On critical alert, convene cross-agency review; cross-link LMS-login and infirmary-use data to detect hidden non-attendance; deploy SC/SSW resources.
Rationale: Equivalent to a population-level disease incidence indicator in PHM; early flow detection enables 2nd-tier preventive intervention before chronicity.

Indicator_Name_JP: 中途退学率
Definition: Annual high-school dropout rate by reason category (academic, economic, career change, interpersonal), distinct from transfer.
Data_Source: MEXT Basic School Survey; school administrative deregistration records
Threshold: >1.5x national mean: warning; YoY +20%: critical; single reason >50% of dropouts: structural-factor analysis required
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Academic Affairs Chief)
Action_Trigger: Trigger reason-specific intervention design (e.g., economic-aid expansion, career-counseling reinforcement); cross-link GIGA device-usage cessation as leading indicator.
Rationale: Parallels disease-mortality endpoint in PHM; represents irreversible loss to the learning population requiring upstream prevention investment.

Indicator_Name_JP: 特別支援教育対象率推移
Definition: Combined share of students receiving tsukyu (resource-room) instruction, enrolled in special-needs classes, or attending special-needs schools, plus year-over-year change rate.
Data_Source: MEXT Special Needs Education Statistics; Basic School Survey
Threshold: Annual change >15%: investigation required (rapid rise may reflect either improved detection or over-identification); deviation >2SD from national mean: investigation
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Special Needs Education Division)
Action_Trigger: On large change, commission specialist-panel review to distinguish access improvement from over-identification; pair with inclusive-education indicators.
Rationale: PHM analogue is screening-coverage tracking; an increase is not inherently negative when it reflects improved access to appropriate support.

Indicator_Name_JP: 進路決定率
Definition: Share of graduating lower- and upper-secondary students with a determined pathway (further education, employment, or other) at the time of graduation, with profile analysis of the undecided.
Data_Source: Basic School Survey; career guidance records
Threshold: <95%: caution; <90%: warning; YoY drop -3pp: trend alert
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Career Guidance Supervisor; A: School Principal)
Action_Trigger: When provisional December rate signals risk, expand career-counseling capacity and connect undecided students to municipal employment-support services.
Rationale: Corresponds to a discharge-disposition outcome in PHM; measures successful transition out of the K-12 learning population, weighted by self-perceived fit.

Indicator_Name_JP: 学校別学力到達度
Definition: School-level share of students reaching the B-criterion ('generally satisfactory') or above on internal and municipal assessments, by subject and learning domain.
Data_Source: Internal periodic tests; municipal common assessments; NRT/CRT
Threshold: District mean -10pp: caution; -20pp: warning; 2 consecutive semesters of decline: trend alert
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Academic Affairs Chief)
Action_Trigger: Cross-validate internal grading reliability against standardized tests; trigger subject-team intervention planning.
Rationale: Mid-level vital-sign aggregation analogous to ward-level outcome monitoring in PHM; supports IRT-based reliability checks of internal evaluation.

Indicator_Name_JP: 出席率・出席パターン分析
Definition: School-wide attendance rate plus pattern analytics: chronic absenteeism share, day-of-week absence pattern, late-arrival and infirmary-use integration.
Data_Source: School administrative system attendance module
Threshold: <95%: caution; <90%: warning; chronic absenteeism >10%: critical; specific weekday +3pp above overall: pattern alert
Decision_Owner: Vice-Principal (R: Vice-Principal; C: Yougo (school nurse) teacher)
Action_Trigger: On weekday-pattern alert (e.g., Monday spike) deploy targeted homeroom outreach; chronic absentees enter early-warning monitoring (S-LRS-02).
Rationale: Attendance is the most sensitive vital sign for population learning health; weekday/period patterns are leading indicators of futoukou onset.

Indicator_Name_JP: 授業時数充足率
Definition: Ratio of delivered to standard instructional hours per the Course of Study, by subject and grade, with tracking of unfulfilled hours and reasons.
Data_Source: Timetable management system; teaching records
Threshold: <98%: caution; <95%: warning (curriculum-policy issue); subject-specific <90%: subject-level critical alert
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Academic Affairs Chief)
Action_Trigger: On shortfall, log cause (disaster / pandemic / staffing) and authorize make-up modalities including online delivery; report to municipal authority.
Rationale: PHM analogue is service-delivery coverage; ensures upstream input integrity before evaluating downstream learning outcomes.

Indicator_Name_JP: 学校適応感指数
Definition: Distribution of students across Q-U adaptation typology (satisfied / non-aggrieved / perceived-victimization / maladjusted) reported as a composite weighted index.
Data_Source: Q-U (QUESTIONNAIRE-UTILITIES) survey administered via GIGA devices
Threshold: Maladjusted group >15%: caution; >25%: warning; -5pt vs previous wave: trend alert
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Counseling Coordinator; C: School Counselor)
Action_Trigger: On warning, initiate class-climate intervention; cross-analyze Q-U with academic data to evaluate the classroom-management–attainment linkage.
Rationale: Captures the psychosocial dimension of population learning health, analogous to mental-health screening in PHM; high predictive validity for futoukou.

Indicator_Name_EN: Teacher Staffing Sufficiency and Placement Adequacy
Indicator_Name_JP: 教職員充足率・配置適正度
Definition: Ratio of actual to statutory staffing, supplemented by qualitative measures (license-subject match rate and experience-balance) to assess placement quality.
Data_Source: HR personnel system; teacher license registry
Threshold: Staffing <95%: critical; license-match <80%: caution; any mid-year vacancy: immediate alert
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: HR Division; A: Superintendent; I: Teachers' unions)
Action_Trigger: Trigger emergency-recruitment protocol; expose 'hidden shortage' (high non-regular share) via employment-type breakdown analysis.
Rationale: Functions as the staffing-equivalent vital sign of a hospital; the infrastructure layer of PLM whose degradation cascades into student outcomes.

Indicator_Name_JP: クラス別・単元別学力到達率
Definition: Per-class share of students reaching unit learning objectives, paired with mastery-pace and concentration of common error patterns (misconception clustering).
Data_Source: Unit tests; formative assessment; digital drill correctness logs
Threshold: <80%: re-teaching considered; <60%: critical re-teaching; specific misconception pattern >30%: focused-instruction notification
Decision_Owner: Homeroom/Subject Teacher (A: Grade Chief)
Action_Trigger: Trigger AI-assisted misconception classification and targeted re-teaching; integrate with Teach-to-AI activities for deeper repair.
Rationale: Classroom-level vital sign; the fastest feedback loop for formative correction and the basis for AI-driven misconception clustering.

Indicator_Name_EN: Individual Learning Progress and Mastery Monitoring
Indicator_Name_JP: 個別学習進捗・習得モニタリング
Definition: Per-student LMS-derived monitoring of plan-progress ratio, learning density, and the regression slope of recent comprehension scores.
Data_Source: LMS (Google Classroom / LoiLoNote); digital drills; xAPI/cmi5 LRS
Threshold: -20% vs plan: caution (individual check-in); -40%: warning (1:1 meeting); 3 consecutive days no login: alert; negative comprehension trend: support needed
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (C: ICT Support; I: Parent portal)
Action_Trigger: Initiate tailored adjustment of the learning plan; granularity of view differs between teacher and parent dashboards to protect privacy.
Rationale: Continuous monitoring of the individual learner; the micro-layer analogue of bedside vital-sign telemetry in clinical practice.

Indicator_Name_EN: Individual Attendance Trajectory and Early Warning Score
Indicator_Name_JP: 出席率推移・早期警戒スコア（個人）
Definition: 30-day rolling attendance trajectory combined with an ML-derived early warning score (0-100) using attendance trend, tardiness, infirmary use, academic variability, and LMS login decline.
Data_Source: School administrative system; infirmary records; LMS logs (integrated data lake)
Threshold: 2-week downtrend: info (watch); 3-week downtrend: caution (teacher 1:1); EWS >=70: warning (SC referral); EWS >=85: critical (support-team convened)
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (A: Vice-Principal; C: SC/SSW)
Action_Trigger: On EWS escalation, activate Tier-2/3 wraparound support per Learning Pathway; periodically retune FP/FN balance of the predictive model.
Rationale: Direct PHM analogue of Modified Early Warning Score (MEWS); operationalizes risk stratification at the individual-student bedside.

Indicator_Name_JP: リスク層別人口分布
Definition: Distribution of all students across Level 1-4 of the Learning Risk Pyramid (autonomous / at-risk / persistent difficulty / complex difficulty) and deviation from the ideal distribution shape.
Data_Source: Integrated risk-stratification model (multivariate algorithm fusing LVS, SDoL, LE)
Threshold: L3+L4 >20%: policy review; >25%: emergency policy response; deviation index >0.15: structural analysis
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Policy Division; C: Researchers)
Action_Trigger: Trigger municipal-level resource re-allocation; publish 'net risk rate' adjusted for SDoL alongside the raw distribution.
Rationale: Direct transfer of the Kaiser Permanente Pyramid; transforms 'uniform support for all' into 'risk-stratified optimal allocation' — the core of PHM applied to education.

Indicator_Name_JP: 予測モデル精度・公平性指標
Definition: Ongoing audit of risk-prediction models on accuracy (AUC-ROC, precision, recall, F1) and group fairness (max-min disparity of FPR across protected attributes).
Data_Source: Model evaluation logs; backtests against realized outcomes
Threshold: AUC<0.75: model improvement required; fairness gap >0.10: bias remediation required; recall <0.70: under-detection risk
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Data Scientist; C: Ethics Review Board; I: Parent representatives)
Action_Trigger: Convene model-review and ethics-board session; mandate SHAP-based explainability artifacts before re-deployment.
Rationale: PHM analogue is clinical-decision-support validation; institutionalizes algorithmic accountability and prevents discriminatory mis-classification.

Indicator_Name_JP: 層間移動率（改善率・悪化率）
Definition: Quarterly transition rates between risk levels, decomposed into improvement (level down), deterioration (level up), and net improvement.
Data_Source: Longitudinal comparison of risk-stratification records
Threshold: Net improvement negative: policy revision; deterioration >15%: emergency analysis; concentrated L2->L3 transitions: 2nd-tier prevention reinforcement
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Curriculum Supervisor)
Action_Trigger: Reallocate prevention budget toward the dominant failing transition (e.g., L2->L3); track re-deterioration rate to avoid premature de-escalation.
Rationale: Analogue of disease-progression tracking in chronic-care registries; flow data is the true measure of system effectiveness, not the stock alone.

Indicator_Name_JP: 複合リスク集積指数
Definition: Share of students carrying risk flags in 3 or more of 5 domains (academic, attendance, behavioral, family environment, health), plus mean flag count among the affected.
Data_Source: Multivariate integration of LVS + SDoL + LE flags
Threshold: >5%: reinforce wraparound support; >8%: emergency response; geographic/school concentration: structural-factor analysis
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Policy Division; C: Welfare Department)
Action_Trigger: Convene multi-agency case conference (education + welfare + medical + judicial) per integrated case-management protocol.
Rationale: Mirrors high-cost / high-need patient identification in PHM; compound-risk students live 'in the gaps between systems' and require inter-agency coordination.

Indicator_Name_EN: Within-School Risk Distribution and Inter-Class Deviation
Indicator_Name_JP: 校内リスク層別分布・クラス間偏差
Definition: Distribution of Levels 1-4 within the school, plus inter-class deviation analysis to detect risk concentration in specific classrooms.
Data_Source: School-wide integrated risk data
Threshold: Inter-class SD >10pp: class-composition review required; concentration index >1.8: targeted support for specific class
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Vice-Principal; C: Counseling Coordinator)
Action_Trigger: Feed into next-year class-composition algorithm; deploy additional in-class support to high-concentration classes mid-year.
Rationale: Detects iatrogenic risk concentration produced by class assignment; prevents 'risk ghetto' classrooms that undermine equitable outcomes.

Indicator_Name_JP: 早期警戒対象者モニタリング
Definition: Roster of students whose risk level rose vs the prior month or showed sudden behavioral shift, with tracking of response-action coverage.
Data_Source: Risk monitoring system; intervention logs
Threshold: MoM +20%: emergency response; response coverage <70%: support-capacity alert
Decision_Owner: Vice-Principal (R: Counseling Coordinator; C: SC)
Action_Trigger: Assign owner within 1 week of escalation; verify intervention quality via subsequent risk-score change rather than action-count alone.
Rationale: Operationalizes 'rounds' in clinical wards as the weekly case-conference cycle; ensures rising-risk students are never lost between handoffs.

Indicator_Name_EN: RTI/MTPSS Support Tier Distribution and Transition Rate
Indicator_Name_JP: 支援Tier分布・移行率
Definition: RTI/MTPSS-based distribution of students across Tier 1-3 with semester-to-semester escalation and de-escalation rates.
Data_Source: School-based support registry; in-house support committee records
Threshold: Tier 3 share >5%: specialist-resource verification; Tier de-escalation rate <30%: review intervention effectiveness
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Special Needs Coordinator)
Action_Trigger: Reconcile Tier assignment with LRS Level mapping; trigger intervention-method revision when de-escalation stalls.
Rationale: RTI/MTPSS is the closest indigenous educational analogue of the Kaiser Pyramid; this indicator harmonizes the two taxonomies for unified action.

Indicator_Name_EN: Individual Risk Score with SHAP Factor Decomposition
Indicator_Name_JP: 個人リスクスコア・要因分解
Definition: Composite individual risk score (0-100) with level mapping and SHAP-value decomposition of contributing factors at the individual level.
Data_Source: Integrated risk model (LVS + SDoL + LE features)
Threshold: 50-69: caution (L2); 70-84: warning (L3); >=85: critical (L4)
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (A: Vice-Principal; C: SC; I: Parent — summary only)
Action_Trigger: Initiate Learning Pathway-defined Tier-appropriate intervention; do NOT disclose raw score to the student; convey factor-level guidance to parents.
Rationale: Mirrors per-patient risk profiles in chronic-care registries; the SHAP layer is essential for the 'AI symbiosis, not predation' design principle.

Indicator_Name_JP: 学習行動変化の自動検知
Definition: Statistical anomaly detection on LMS behavioral logs (submission rate, login cadence, participation, response patterns) against the student's own 30-day baseline.
Data_Source: LMS behavioral logs (xAPI-compliant)
Threshold: |Z|>2.0 for 3 consecutive days: auto-alert (teacher); |Z|>3.0: immediate alert (incl. Vice-Principal); multi-indicator co-anomaly: critical
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (C: ICT Support; I: Parent on need)
Action_Trigger: Trigger context-aware false-positive filter (exam periods, school events); on confirmed anomaly, escalate to T-LRS-03 case follow-up.
Rationale: Continuous telemetry analogue of ICU anomaly detection; catches behavior change before it surfaces in attendance or grades.

Indicator_Name_EN: Individual Intervention History and Effect Tracking
Indicator_Name_JP: 介入履歴・効果追跡（個人）
Definition: Individual chart of every intervention applied with pre-post risk-score change (4-week window), cumulative count, and intervention-response rate.
Data_Source: Intervention log system cross-joined with risk-score data
Threshold: 3 consecutive ineffective cycles: change method; response rate <30%: re-analyze underlying factors
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (A: Vice-Principal; C: Special Needs Coordinator)
Action_Trigger: Re-enter the student into Learning Pathway with adjusted modality; document deviation rationale from the standard pathway.
Rationale: Educational analogue of the clinical pathway; transforms tacit teacher knowledge into auditable, comparable intervention evidence.

Indicator_Name_EN: School Aid Recipient Rate and Economic Hardship Index
Indicator_Name_JP: 就学援助受給率・経済的困窮指数
Definition: Share of students in protected / quasi-protected aid categories, combined with welfare-recipient and tax-exempt household shares into a composite hardship index (0-100).
Data_Source: School-aid administrative data; welfare-department data (statistical linkage)
Threshold: >1.3x national mean: priority area designation; >1.5x: emergency support area; YoY +3pp: trend alert
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Student Affairs Division; C: Welfare Department)
Action_Trigger: Trigger application-simplification campaign to reduce non-take-up; weight subsequent resource allocation toward designated areas.
Rationale: Direct transfer of the income/poverty axis of SDoH; structural determinant of LVS-M01 attainment distribution requiring upstream policy response.

Indicator_Name_JP: 多文化・多言語環境指数
Definition: Share of students requiring Japanese-language instruction, Shannon-index linguistic diversity, and interpreter coverage rate combined into a composite.
Data_Source: MEXT Survey on Students Needing Japanese-Language Instruction; foreign-resident statistics; DLA-equivalent assessments
Threshold: Multilingual share >5%: build multicultural support system; interpreter coverage <50%: emergency response
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: International Education Division; C: Multicultural Affairs)
Action_Trigger: Expand JSL curriculum and 'plain Japanese' implementation; commission community-interpreter pool.
Rationale: Analogue of cultural-competence indicators in PHM; equity dimension of SDoL most often invisible in district averages.

Indicator_Name_EN: Regional Educational Resource Density and Access Index
Indicator_Name_JP: 地域教育資源密度・アクセス指数
Definition: Per-capita density of educational and cultural facilities (libraries, museums, cram schools, NPO learning support, sports venues) weighted by transit accessibility.
Data_Source: GIS integrated facility data; transit network data
Threshold: Bottom 25% region: complementary policy review; bottom 10%: priority development area
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Social Education Division; C: Urban Planning Department)
Action_Trigger: Substitute physical scarcity with digital-resource provision; evaluate isochrone-based access gaps for planning intervention.
Rationale: Analogue of healthcare-desert mapping in PHM; structural inequity that no single school can remediate on its own.

Indicator_Name_JP: デジタルディバイド指数
Definition: Household-level composite of broadband connectivity, device ownership, digital literacy, and parental ICT competence, calibrated on GIGA-device usage data.
Data_Source: Home environment survey; MIC ICT-use statistics; GIGA device usage logs
Threshold: >10% un-equipped: emergency response (device loan / Wi-Fi provision); low-literacy >20%: deploy digital-support program
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: ICT Promotion Division; C: Information Policy Division)
Action_Trigger: Trigger mobile-hotspot / device-loan program; pair school-based parent ICT literacy program with regular outreach.
Rationale: 21st-century SDoL axis with no PHM precedent in original frameworks; critical for AI-era learning equity and Teach-to-AI feasibility.

Indicator_Name_EN: Child Poverty and Multidimensional Deprivation Indicator
Indicator_Name_JP: 子どもの貧困・生活困窮指標
Definition: Relative child-poverty rate combined with a deprivation index counting necessities and experiential activities economically out of reach.
Data_Source: MHLW Comprehensive Survey of Living Conditions; municipal child-life surveys; welfare data
Threshold: >national mean: priority policy area; YoY +2pp: trend alert; deprivation top 20%: direct support program review
Decision_Owner: Mayor's Office (R: Child Policy Division; C: Superintendent of Education; I: NGO partners)
Action_Trigger: Convene cross-departmental child-poverty council; route deprivation-flagged students to school-meal expansion and experiential-activity vouchers.
Rationale: Multidimensional poverty mirrors the WHO SDoH frame more faithfully than income alone; requires city-hall partnership beyond the education board.

Indicator_Name_JP: 学校区SDoLスコア
Definition: Catchment-level composite (0-100) of the five Macro SDoL dimensions, computed via spatial join of GIS school boundaries with source datasets.
Data_Source: Spatial aggregation of macro indicator sources to catchment boundaries
Threshold: Bottom 20%: priority-support school designation; YoY -5pt: trend alert
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: School Support Division; A: Superintendent; I: Community representatives)
Action_Trigger: Provide evidence base for weighted budget allocation to designated priority-support schools.
Rationale: Translates macro-level SDoH atlases into operational catchment scoring used by managed-care organizations; the bridge between policy and school management.

Indicator_Name_JP: 保護者エンゲージメント指標
Definition: Composite of parent participation in school activities, response rate to school communications, event attendance, and parent-conference attendance.
Data_Source: School communication apps (e.g., Manabi-Pocket); event participation records
Threshold: Response rate <60%: improve communication channels; participation <30%: strengthen outreach
Decision_Owner: Vice-Principal (R: Vice-Principal; C: PTA)
Action_Trigger: Diagnose root cause (language / working hours / digital literacy) rather than labeling as disengagement; localize and translate communications.
Rationale: Family engagement is the PHM-PLM analogue of caregiver engagement in chronic care; consistently predictive of learner outcomes.

Indicator_Name_EN: Commuting Safety and Local Environment Indicator
Indicator_Name_JP: 地域安全・通学環境指標
Definition: Composite of traffic-accident incidence, crime rate, disaster-risk assessment, and commuting-distance adequacy across the school catchment.
Data_Source: Police statistics; GIS data; commuting-route safety audits
Threshold: Bottom 20% safety index: commuting-route improvement request; serious incident: immediate alert
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: School Safety Division; A: Superintendent; C: Police, Disaster Prevention Division; I: Parents)
Action_Trigger: Trigger inter-agency safety review and route remediation; pair with perceived-safety surveys to capture subjective dimension.
Rationale: Built-environment safety is a direct SDoH transfer; physical safety is a precondition for attendance and engagement.

Indicator_Name_JP: 個人SDoLプロファイル
Definition: Five-axis profile (economic, family, cultural, housing, digital) per student, with a composite risk flag triggered when 3+ axes score 2 or below.
Data_Source: Home survey; interview records; welfare data (where linkage is permitted)
Threshold: Risk flag: case-conference review; deterioration in 2+ axes vs prior wave: urgent verification
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (A: Vice-Principal; C: SSW; I: Parent on consent)
Action_Trigger: Convene wraparound support team; enforce strict role-based access control and purpose-limitation on this profile.
Rationale: The most sensitive data in PLM; must be paired with the strictest privacy protocols and stewardship to avoid stigma and deficit framing.

Indicator_Name_EN: Home Learning Environment and Support System Evaluation
Indicator_Name_JP: 家庭学習環境・支援体制評価
Definition: Student-reported assessment of study space, quiet environment, study-time feasibility, parental academic support, and sibling effects on home learning.
Data_Source: Student survey on GIGA devices (early-term); home-visit records
Threshold: Environment score <=2: provide after-school learning support; no support system: provide school-completion learning model
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (A: Grade Chief; C: SSW; I: Parent)
Action_Trigger: Reframe finding as 'school provides what home cannot' rather than labeling the family; allocate space and time accordingly.
Rationale: Operationalizes the home-environment SDoH dimension at the bedside-equivalent level of the teacher-student relationship.

Indicator_Name_EN: Policy Intervention Effect Size and Meta-Analysis
Indicator_Name_JP: 政策介入効果サイズ・メタ分析
Definition: Municipal-level Cohen's d for pre-post policy effects, combined across schools via inverse-variance-weighted meta-analysis with 95% CI.
Data_Source: Policy-evaluation data (intervention vs comparison groups, RCT or quasi-experimental)
Threshold: d<0.2: no effect (revise policy); 0.2<=d<0.5: small; 0.5<=d<0.8: medium; d>=0.8: large; Hattie hinge d=0.4 as reference line
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Policy Division; C: Researchers; I: Council)
Action_Trigger: Trigger systematic review of underperforming programs and reallocation toward d>=0.4 portfolio.
Rationale: Direct transfer of EBM's effect-size standard to education; ends 'plausibility-only' policy-making in favor of magnitude-comparable evidence.

Indicator_Name_JP: 教育プログラム費用対効果（ICER）
Definition: Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio comparing new vs existing programs, defined as cost difference per unit improvement in learning outcomes or risk-level reduction.
Data_Source: Financial accounting × outcome data
Threshold: ICER above municipal willingness-to-pay threshold: review alternative programs; ROI<0: investment not recoverable
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Policy Division; C: Fiscal Division; I: Council)
Action_Trigger: Trigger comparative review against What Works Clearinghouse ICER benchmarks; refine indirect-cost allocation rules.
Rationale: Direct transfer of ICER from health economics; introduces value-based reasoning into educational budgeting beyond per-pupil spending.

Indicator_Name_EN: Intervention Coverage Rate and Access Equity
Indicator_Name_JP: 介入カバレッジ率・アクセス公平性
Definition: Share of eligible students actually receiving interventions, plus access-gap analysis across SDoL attribute subgroups.
Data_Source: Intervention log aggregates cross-tabulated with risk-stratification data and SDoL attributes
Threshold: <80%: improve access; access gap >20pp between subgroups: equity remediation
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Curriculum Supervisor; C: Principals)
Action_Trigger: Address the 'inverse care law' (highest-risk receive least support); deploy active outreach to under-covered L3-L4 students.
Rationale: Core PHM indicator: a treatment that does not reach those who need it most cannot improve population outcomes.

Indicator_Name_JP: エビデンスレベル分布・成熟度
Definition: Share of municipal programs at each evidence level (L1 RCT, L2 quasi-experimental, L3 observational, L4 expert opinion, L5 anecdote).
Data_Source: Program registry (newly established)
Threshold: L4+L5 >50%: accelerate evidence-base transition; L1+L2 <20%: strengthen research partnership
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Research Institute; C: Researchers)
Action_Trigger: Migrate weakest-evidence programs to a research-partnership track for upgrade rather than abrupt termination.
Rationale: Parallels the GRADE evidence-tier system in clinical guidelines; institutionalizes the gradient from craft to evidence-based practice.

Indicator_Name_JP: 学校別介入ポートフォリオ効果
Definition: Standardized pre-post effect of each school program plus a portfolio-interaction term capturing synergy or interference across concurrent programs.
Data_Source: Internal evaluation data; intervention logs
Threshold: Any program with no effect: consider alternative; negative synergy: analyze interference; detect 'program overload' (teacher burden exceeds benefit)
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Research Chief; C: Curriculum Supervisor)
Action_Trigger: Retire underperforming programs to reduce burden; document and propagate positive-synergy combinations across the district.
Rationale: Real-world programs interact; this indicator detects when adding interventions becomes counterproductive — a typical pitfall in well-meaning school reform.

Indicator_Name_EN: IEP Achievement Rate and Qualitative Evaluation
Indicator_Name_JP: 個別支援計画達成率・質的評価
Definition: Per-student IEP goal achievement rate aggregated to the school level, paired with qualitative scores on plan adequacy, parental participation, and multi-professional collaboration.
Data_Source: Individualized education plan management system
Threshold: Achievement <60%: redesign plan; quality score <3: improve plan-formulation process
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Special Needs Coordinator; C: Curriculum Supervisor; I: Parent)
Action_Trigger: Audit goal-setting for 'low-bar' goals; ensure challenging-but-realistic target calibration; engage parents earlier in goal formulation.
Rationale: PHM analogue is individualized care-plan adherence; quality of the plan itself (not only its execution) determines outcomes.

Indicator_Name_JP: AI活用教育の導入効果
Definition: School-level effect of AI-enhanced programs (Teach-to-AI, adaptive learning AI, AI-supported lesson design) measured against non-AI baseline, with depth-of-use staging.
Data_Source: AI tool logs × academic data × teacher evaluations
Threshold: d>0.3 vs conventional: effective (scale up); depth of use stuck at level <=2: strengthen professional development
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: ICT Lead Teacher; C: Researchers; I: Board of Education)
Action_Trigger: Promote progression from substitution-level use toward Teach-to-AI and co-construction modes; capture co-evolutionary scaffolding landing-space metrics.
Rationale: Operationalizes the co-evolutionary scaffolding theory; distinguishes shallow AI substitution from deep AI-symbiotic learning.

Indicator_Name_EN: Single-Case Experimental Design Evaluation of Individual Instruction
Indicator_Name_JP: 個別指導介入のSingle Case Design評価
Definition: A-B-A or related SCED evaluation of individual-instruction effects using baseline-vs-intervention level change, slope change, and Percentage of Non-overlapping Data (PND).
Data_Source: Formative-assessment data; behavioral observation records
Threshold: PND>70%: effective; 50-70%: equivocal; <50%: ineffective (change method); 3 ineffective cycles: fundamental redesign
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (A: Special Needs Coordinator; C: Curriculum Supervisor; I: Parent)
Action_Trigger: Trigger method substitution per pathway; package SCED basics into teacher professional development.
Rationale: Brings the rigor of N-of-1 trials into teacher practice; the bedside-research equivalent in education.

Indicator_Name_JP: Teach-to-AI活動の学習効果
Definition: Effect of teach-to-AI activities on retention, metacognitive change (precision of student explanations to AI), and transfer to novel problems.
Data_Source: AI tool logs (explanation quality, revision count); test data
Threshold: Retention ratio >=1.2x: effective; metacognition trend up: deep learning evidence; transfer success >=60%: applied-competence gain
Decision_Owner: Homeroom/Subject Teacher (A: Grade Chief; C: Researchers; I: Parent)
Action_Trigger: Analyze AI 'mis-learning' patterns to inform teacher formative-assessment practice; expand Teach-to-AI tasks where retention gains are confirmed.
Rationale: Direct operationalization of co-evolutionary scaffolding research; learning by teaching, mediated by AI, deepens metacognition beyond conventional methods.

Indicator_Name_JP: スキャフォールディング段階効果測定
Definition: Effect of scaffolding across introduction-maintenance-fading (or continued AI-partnership) stages, including a landing-success rate four weeks after fading.
Data_Source: Instruction records × formative assessment × LMS logs
Threshold: Landing success >=60%: appropriate fading; <40%: premature fading or low-quality scaffold; stable autonomy in AI-partnership stage: co-evolution achieved
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (A: Academic Affairs Chief; C: Researchers; I: Parent)
Action_Trigger: Calibrate fading timing per student; design for sustainable AI partnership when full fading is not the goal.
Rationale: Direct instantiation of Sasano's co-evolutionary scaffolding theory; evaluates both 'fade-and-go' and 'permanent partnership' models within one framework.

Indicator_Name_EN: Per-Student Expenditure vs Outcome Value Index
Indicator_Name_JP: 児童生徒一人当たり教育費・成果対比
Definition: Per-student educational spending paired with achievement outcomes; Value Index normalizes outcome-per-yen against the national average.
Data_Source: MIC Survey of Local Education Expenditure; Basic School Survey
Threshold: Value Index <0.8: cost-efficiency concern; deviation from national mean (±2SD): analysis required
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Finance Division; C: Fiscal Division; I: Council)
Action_Trigger: Always pair with outcome quality to avoid 'cheap but ineffective'; investigate cost-quality dyads jointly.
Rationale: Operationalizes Value-Based Healthcare principles in education: outcomes per yen rather than inputs alone.

Indicator_Name_JP: 予防的投資比率
Definition: Share of education budget allocated to primary-prevention (universal) measures, compared with the share for tertiary (reactive) response.
Data_Source: Budget data classified by intervention tier
Threshold: Prevention <30%: review allocation; prevention/reactive ratio <1.0: rebalance toward upstream investment
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Policy Division; C: Fiscal Division; I: Council)
Action_Trigger: Construct multi-year case for prevention investment with projected reactive-cost avoidance; pre-define mapping rules from budget codes to tiers.
Rationale: Mirrors the PHM finding that upstream investment lowers long-run cost; reframes education budgeting away from reactive crisis spending.

Indicator_Name_EN: ICT Investment ROI and Utilization Maturity
Indicator_Name_JP: ICT投資対効果・活用成熟度
Definition: ICT investment efficiency (utilization per spend), SAMR-stage utilization maturity, and learning-effect size attributable to ICT-enabled lessons.
Data_Source: ICT inventory; utilization surveys; GIGA device usage logs
Threshold: Utilization <50%: strengthen PD; SAMR <1.5: 'paper-replacement' stagnation; no learning effect: fundamental rethink
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: ICT Promotion Division; C: CIO; I: Teachers)
Action_Trigger: Move from substitution to modification/redefinition through PD; surface app-category heatmaps to guide practice.
Rationale: Adapts SAMR as the maturity model; the GIGA program is measured not by device count but by transformation depth.

Indicator_Name_JP: 教員人材サステナビリティ指標
Definition: Composite of recruitment fulfillment, turnover, mental-health long-leave rate, and a derived sustainability index measuring workforce health.
Data_Source: HR personnel system
Threshold: Sustainability index <70: caution; <60: emergency (accelerate work-style reform); mental-health leave >2%: workplace remediation
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: HR Division; C: Occupational Physician; I: Teachers' unions)
Action_Trigger: Trigger workload reduction, AI-assisted task offload, and mental-health support; treat workforce as critical infrastructure.
Rationale: Frames teacher workforce as the human-infrastructure analogue of healthcare staffing crises; degradation cascades into every other PLM domain.

Indicator_Name_JP: 教員業務時間構成分析
Definition: Breakdown of teacher work hours across instruction, lesson preparation, student guidance, administration, club activities, and PD, with overtime tracking.
Data_Source: IC-card attendance system; teacher self-logging
Threshold: Instructional share <60%: business-process improvement; monthly overtime >80h: overwork-line emergency; >45h for 3 consecutive months: early warning
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Vice-Principal; C: HR Division)
Action_Trigger: Shift administrative load to AI/automation; quantify the AI-attributable hour-savings as the basis for further investment.
Rationale: Operationalizes work-time as a measurable input variable; without it, AI-efficiency claims remain anecdotal.

Indicator_Name_EN: Facility and Equipment Utilization and Optimization Index
Indicator_Name_JP: 施設・設備稼働率・最適化指数
Definition: Utilization rates of classrooms, specialist rooms, ICT equipment, and PE facilities, plus an optimization index based on variance across facility types.
Data_Source: Facility booking system; usage records
Threshold: Utilization <30%: reassign or multipurpose; >90%: capacity shortage
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Business Manager; C: Facilities Division; I: Teachers)
Action_Trigger: Promote STEAM-supporting specialist-room utilization; rebalance schedule to equalize use.
Rationale: Standard asset-utilization analytics imported from operations management; previously absent in many K-12 schools.

Indicator_Name_JP: AI活用による業務効率化指標
Definition: AI-attributable reduction in teacher workload (time saved) combined with qualitative-improvement self-assessment on instruction, individualization, and feedback.
Data_Source: AI usage logs × work-hours data × teacher surveys
Threshold: >=10 hours saved per month: target achieved; no qualitative improvement: review usage patterns
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: ICT Lead Teacher; C: Board of Education; I: All teachers)
Action_Trigger: Track where freed time is redirected; the ideal redirection is increased dialogue with students rather than additional administrative load.
Rationale: Closes the loop on M-RE-03 by confirming whether AI investment translates into reclaimed teacher time and qualitative improvement.

Indicator_Name_EN: Lesson Preparation Efficiency and AI Utilization
Indicator_Name_JP: 授業準備効率・AI活用度
Definition: Teacher-level lesson-preparation time and AI utilization share, paired with self-rated lesson quality to capture the time-quality dyad.
Data_Source: Teacher self-logs; AI usage logs
Threshold: Target: 30% reduction in preparation time vs pre-AI baseline; if quality drops: review usage approach
Decision_Owner: Teacher (A: Grade Chief; C: ICT Lead Teacher; I: Principal)
Action_Trigger: Treat AI as a means, not an end; reject AI-enabled efficiency that erodes instructional quality.
Rationale: Individual-level analogue of S-RE-03; protects against the perverse incentive of 'efficiency at the cost of teaching quality.'

Indicator_Name_EN: Individualized Support Capacity and Quality Indicator
Indicator_Name_JP: 個別対応キャパシティ・質指標
Definition: Number of students individually supported per week × support quality (depth-weighted), normalized by the teacher's instructional load.
Data_Source: Instruction records; work-time data
Threshold: Quality score <=2 sustained: overload; capacity index sudden drop: add support resources
Decision_Owner: Teacher (A: Vice-Principal; C: Grade Chief; I: Support Staff)
Action_Trigger: Reinforce with support-staff allocation when overload is sustained; track AI-enabled capacity gains separately.
Rationale: Surfaces the quantity-quality trade-off in individualization; without it, individualization mandates can silently erode quality.

Indicator_Name_JP: 教員ウェルビーイング指標
Definition: Composite of job satisfaction, inverse stress, self-efficacy, and collegial relationships, plus a Maslach Burnout Inventory-derived burnout-risk score.
Data_Source: Anonymous pulse surveys (monthly short form, quarterly long form)
Threshold: Score <50: individual support recommended; high burnout risk: occupational physician referral; school mean <60: organizational improvement
Decision_Owner: Teacher self-report (A: Principal; C: Occupational Physician, SC; I: HR Division)
Action_Trigger: Provide confidential support; aggregate trends drive organizational-level interventions rather than individual blame.
Rationale: Teacher wellbeing is strongly correlated with student learning outcomes; the PLM infrastructure-health indicator par excellence.

Indicator_Name_JP: 学習エンゲージメント総合指数
Definition: Tri-dimensional composite of behavioral engagement (participation), cognitive engagement (deep-learning strategy use), and emotional engagement (intrinsic interest, belonging, self-efficacy).
Data_Source: Behavioral data (LMS / attendance) + survey + learning-strategy inventory
Threshold: Composite -0.5SD vs national mean: caution; <-1SD: warning; behavioral high but cognitive low: 'pseudo-engagement' alert; sudden emotional drop: mental-health caution
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Policy Division; C: Researchers; I: Principals)
Action_Trigger: Diagnose the dimension dragging the composite; tailor district response (e.g., metacognitive PD vs belonging interventions).
Rationale: Direct educational transfer of the Patient Activation Measure; protects against 'going through the motions' visible only in cognitive-dimension data.

Indicator_Name_EN: Active Learning Participation Rate and PAM-E Stage Distribution
Indicator_Name_JP: 主体的学習参加率・PAM教育版段階
Definition: Share of students participating in at least one active learning activity (inquiry, extracurriculars, volunteering), and the four-stage PAM-E activation distribution.
Data_Source: Activity records; PAM-E questionnaire (newly developed)
Threshold: Participation <50%: expand opportunities; Stage 1 >30%: strengthen motivational policy; Stage 4 <20%: expand autonomy-support programs
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Education Policy Division; C: Researchers; I: Principals)
Action_Trigger: Develop and validate PAM-E nationally; the instrument itself is intended as a research contribution.
Rationale: Direct educational analog of PAM, the most-cited patient-activation instrument in healthcare; tracks the passive-to-self-directed continuum.

Indicator_Name_JP: 自己調整学習能力分布
Definition: Distribution across metacognitive strategies, cognitive strategies, and motivational strategies (MSLQ short form), with low-group share tracking.
Data_Source: MSLQ short form (or municipal-equivalent) administered via GIGA devices
Threshold: Low group >25%: introduce SRL program; >40%: emergency district-wide initiative
Decision_Owner: Superintendent (R: Curriculum Supervisor; C: Researchers; I: Teachers)
Action_Trigger: Trigger curriculum embedding of self-regulation strategies; cross-tabulate the low group with SDoL to plan equity-sensitive responses.
Rationale: Increasingly critical in the AI era to prevent over-reliance; cultivates learners who do not 'over-delegate' to AI partners.

Indicator_Name_JP: 学校エンゲージメント環境スコア
Definition: Qualitative composite of school-provided engagement-supporting features: instructional interactivity, choice opportunities, student-self-governance, creative activities, and psychological safety.
Data_Source: Lesson-observation rubric; student surveys; activity records
Threshold: Score <60: improvement plan required; -1SD vs district mean: priority support
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Research Chief; C: Curriculum Supervisor; I: Teachers)
Action_Trigger: Cross-correlate environment score with student engagement composite to identify highest-leverage environmental factors.
Rationale: Captures the school's enabling environment as a measurable property; engagement is co-produced by learner and setting.

Indicator_Name_JP: 探究学習の質的深度
Definition: Rubric-based stage rating of inquiry activities (1: search-and-copy, 2: summarize-organize, 3: analyze-evaluate, 4: hypothesis-testing, 5: knowledge creation) averaged at the school level.
Data_Source: Inquiry-activity rubric (teacher and peer evaluation)
Threshold: Mean depth <2.0: improve inquiry instruction; >60% at stage 1: fundamental redesign of inquiry lessons
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Integrated Learning Lead; C: Curriculum Supervisor; I: Community partners)
Action_Trigger: Extend rubric to capture AI-as-inquiry-partner depth; provide modeling and coaching to lift average depth.
Rationale: Measures quality, not the mere presence, of inquiry; in the AI era, surface-level 'search-and-copy' inquiry is the dominant risk.

Indicator_Name_JP: 学校帰属意識・居場所感指数
Definition: Survey-based composite of belonging ('I feel safe here', 'I am valued') and sense of place ('I have a place at school', 'someone helps me when I struggle').
Data_Source: School-adaptation surveys via GIGA devices
Threshold: Low group (<50) >15%: deploy environment-improvement program; -5pt vs previous wave: analyze environmental change
Decision_Owner: Principal (R: Counseling Coordinator; C: SC; I: Homeroom Teachers)
Action_Trigger: Use low belonging as the leading input to LRS risk modeling; pair with class-level interventions.
Rationale: Belonging is among the strongest leading indicators of futoukou; the bridge between LE and LRS in causal modeling.

Indicator_Name_JP: 授業内エンゲージメント・リアルタイム指標
Definition: Active in-class participation share, digital participation via LMS interactions, and the share of activity at Bloom's higher-order levels (analyze, evaluate, create).
Data_Source: Lesson-observation rubric; LMS logs
Threshold: Participation <40%: redesign lesson; 2-week digital-participation drop: individual check; Bloom upper-tier <20%: raise thinking level
Decision_Owner: Homeroom/Subject Teacher (A: Grade Chief; C: Research Chief; I: Principal)
Action_Trigger: Detect participation skew (active minority dominating); design lessons that broaden participation; lift Bloom-level mix where overly low.
Rationale: Real-time engagement telemetry analogous to monitoring patient response during procedure; ensures broad rather than concentrated participation.

Indicator_Name_JP: 自己効力感・動機づけ推移
Definition: Individual trajectory of academic self-efficacy (Bandura short form) and self-determination-theory motivation profile (amotivation through intrinsic).
Data_Source: Monthly pulse survey (3 items)
Threshold: 3 consecutive months of decline: 1:1 meeting; self-efficacy <1.5: emergency support (SC referral); amotivation state: reconstruct learning meaning
Decision_Owner: Homeroom Teacher (A: Counseling Coordinator; C: SC; I: Parent on need)
Action_Trigger: Treat persistent self-efficacy decline as a possible early marker of depressive symptoms; connect with mental-health monitoring.
Rationale: Self-efficacy collapse is both a learning and a mental-health leading indicator; this indicator bridges LE and student wellbeing.

Indicator_Name_EN: Flow State and Optimal Challenge Achievement Rate
Indicator_Name_JP: フロー状態・最適挑戦レベル達成率
Definition: Frequency of flow-state experience (Csikszentmihalyi) and the time distribution across anxiety / flow / boredom zones based on challenge-skill balance.
Data_Source: Post-lesson 2-item ESM-style pulse; adaptive-learning AI difficulty-setting telemetry
Threshold: Flow rate <1x per week: adjust task difficulty; anxiety zone >30%: lower difficulty; boredom zone >30%: raise difficulty / extension tasks
Decision_Owner: Homeroom/Subject Teacher (A: Grade Chief; C: ICT Lead Teacher; I: Student themselves)
Action_Trigger: Let adaptive-AI auto-tune difficulty toward sustained flow; co-evolutionary scaffolding's operational heart.
Rationale: Integrates flow theory with the adaptive-AI tier; the indicator where co-evolutionary scaffolding becomes computational and real-time.
